[control] use set membership for ordered operators
mutants.why: After the existing VALID_OPERATORS check, values reaching this guard are one of the supported string operators. The tuple and set contain the same two literals, so both choose the same guard and error behavior for every loader input on this path. This argument does not apply to other membership uses or change acceptance of unsupported operators.
